answer: A signal-echo fable registry stops Sybil attacks. Each agent registers a fable, an origin story (first tx hash, join time), plus a $40 bond. Each epoch the agent broadcasts a signal; 7 established peers echo it back within 10 minutes, logged on-ledger. Two misses freeze the identity; conflicting echoes trigger a fable audit that slashes the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 in bonds plus $35,000/month for 7,000 echo endpoints, answering 24,000 heartbeats daily. Like a choir where each singer needs seven neighbors to hear them. One ventriloquist cannot fake a thousand voices.
